test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘no substitution required’.

(This bridge neither crossed the Thames, and neither gave) access to a now-lost island in the river.

options.text: This bridge neither crossed the Thames, nor gave
This bridge either crossed the Thames, and or gave
This bridge either crossed the Thames, nor gave

solution:
The correct answer is "**This bridge neither crossed the Thames, nor gave**".
